messages:
emily_support: Customer reported tool.invoke failing with a JSON schema validation error after upgrading SDK to v1.9. Error: "ValidationError: missing required property 'id' and additionalProperties ["meta_tag"] not allowed". Happening from Dedicated region us-west-2.

emily_support: Pasting minimal repro payload and gateway error we see in logs:
```json
{
  "tool": "invoice.generate",
  "args": {
    "amount": "100.00",    // string instead of number
    "currency": "USD",
    "meta_tag": "promo2026"            // extra property not in schema
    // NOTE: id field omitted entirely
  },
  "session": {
    "user": "acct_abc123"
  }
}
```

emily_support: Gateway log snippet:
`validation failed: instance requires property "id" at /args; instance has additional properties (meta_tag)`

alex_oncall: Ack. Does customer see 400s on every call or only when params include meta_tag?

emily_support: Every call that used the client helper that previously auto-injected id is failing. Looks like helper stopped adding id. If we manually add id (number) the call succeeds.

nina_infra: That helper change was part of the strict-schema rollout yesterday (infra PR #5420) — we switched validation to strict with additionalProperties: false for tool schemas. Might have also toggled auto-coercion off.

kevin_runtime: Can you confirm the type of id the helper used to inject? int vs string? And which SDK version removed it?

emily_support: Old payloads from logs show: `id: 123456` (number). New SDK v1.9 payloads show id missing. Also noticed amount is coming as string which previously was coerced to number by the helper.

alex_oncall: Repro steps for eng: 1) use SDK v1.9 helper to call invoice.generate without id 2) observe 400 with schema error 3) patch helper to inject numeric id or revert strict schema to allow additionalProperties.

kevin_runtime: I can push a quick compatibility shim that re-enables coercion and injects id if absent for the next 24h while we decide the longer-term plan. Prefer to not roll back full strict validation globally.

nina_infra: +1 to a targeted shim. Which code path? SDK or gateway validation? If we change gateway, all older clients benefit.

kevin_runtime: I will add a gateway validation fallback: if required id missing but helper metadata present in headers, auto-insert numeric id; also allow additionalProperties for legacy schemas when header `x-sdk-compat: 1` present. Will open PR shortly.

emily_support: Customer is on a tight billing flow and needs this fixed ASAP. Can we prioritize?

kevin_runtime: Opening emergency PR: github.com/redwood/gateway/pull/5423 — adds compatibility layer + tests. Will request hotfix approval.

support-bot: Created support ticket #SUP-37891 and linked to eng incident INC-2026-042.

alex_oncall: Deployment plan: merge -> canary in us-west-2 for 10% traffic -> monitor 10m for 400-rate & latency regressions -> full rollout. If anything breaks rollback to previous validation behavior.

nina_infra: I'll schedule the canary and watch tracing for any schema-related regressions. Also alerting: create temporary dashboard for `tool.invoke` 4xx rate + `validation.error` tag.

emily_support: I'll notify customer that we have a targeted fix and expect canary within ~45m. Asking them to hold off manual work until canary completes.

kevin_runtime: Patch merged and deployed to canary. Observing logs now. If all good will proceed to full rollout in 30m.

emily_support: Customer confirmed they can retry and saw one successful call after we patched (they added id manually). Will monitor.

alex_oncall: Followup actions: 1) Add regression test preventing id omission for invoice.generate, 2) Update SDK helper to ensure numeric id injection + type coercion, 3) Postmortem on how strict validation was rolled without a compat flag.

emily_support: Thanks team — closing escalation when customer confirms stable for 24h.
